hypothesis: Adapting the last MobileNet blocks to fish images with temporally consistent augmentation improves day-disjoint feeding classification.
initialization: Original ImageNet MobileNetV3 Small and the matching seed's trained GRU; no new downloads
normalization: Keep the original mean/std fitted on training video embeddings only
batch_norm: Frozen running statistics in every block; affine parameters trainable in blocks 9-12

augmentation.policy: New parameters per training clip per epoch, shared by all 16 frames; no frame reordering or validation augmentation

selection: Maximum validation macro-F1, earliest exact tie, including epoch zero (unchanged initialization)
audit_policy: Only after the validation gate passes: evaluate fixed seed 42 once on historical June 22 and already acquired June 27-29 clips. These sets were examined in earlier work and are retrospective audits, not new untouched tests. No further tuning on their results.
scope: Same data, MobileNet and GRU; no claim of reproducing the paper's S3D results or measuring ration savings. Runtime remains unchanged unless all gates pass.
